{07 16 00}I can't believe that
{ff 00 00 06}Tortimer{ff 00 00 00}! Do you know

Over at the {ff 00 00 08}plaza{ff 00 00 00}, prepping
for the countdown tonight!{01 01 00}
{07 01 00}He's been there since dawn!
{07 00 00}He gets all excited for

messages.en:
{07 14 00}You know what made this an

me, {04 1f 00}?

least a little bit of it

spend even more time

{04 1f 00}?

{07 0d 00}Loodan, et saame järgmisel

{07 00 00}Tell me, {04 1f 00},{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 0b 00}was it a good year for you?
